resumeText:
Prashant Kumar Ary - SDET-II / Senior QA Automation Engineer
Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh | prashantkumar231197@gmail.com | 6204507166
http://www.linkedin.com/in/prashant-kumar-ary-336463205

Summary:
Highly skilled IT professional SDET with 3+ years of hands-on experience in manual and automated quality engineering for high-throughput web applications across Enterprise SaaS & Cloud Microservices Platforms. Strong expertise in functional, regression, REST API, and performance testing with deep automation hands-on using Rest Assured and scripting in Python. Proven ability to collaborate with cross-functional agile teams, improve automated test coverage by over 60%, and deliver zero-defect releases under tight timelines. Proven competency in CI/CD pipeline integration, Page Object Model (POM) architectures, and AI-assisted test reconciliation, backed up by exceptional problem-solving acumen and continuous enthusiasm for cutting-edge technologies.

Experience:
Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET). - Corecard India Pvt.Ltd, Bhopal-( Aug 2022 – Present).
• Worked under an Agile/Scrum environment with frequently changing business requirements and rapid release cadences.
• Partnered closely with product engineering teams in Enterprise SaaS & Cloud Microservices Platforms, verifying mission-critical workflows and core transactions.
• Took complete ownership of architecting and scaling robust automation test suites for assigned modules using Rest Assured, achieving 99.4% test run stability.
• Actively designed and developed an AI-assisted test management and log reconciliation tool to analyze automated execution results, identify regressions, classify environment vs code issues, and reduce triage time by 45%.
• Authored comprehensive test plans, edge-case scenarios, and traceability matrices for complex multi-tier microservices.
• Implemented scalable Page Object Model (POM) design patterns with clean reusable components for long-term maintainability.
• Automated end-to-end critical user journeys and automated regression suites executed across daily CI/CD pipelines.
• Engineered robust API validation layers using Postman and Rest Assured, validating JSON payloads, HTTP headers, authentication tokens, and negative boundary cases.
• Integrated Git version control with automated CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions / Jenkins) to trigger automated test gates on pull requests.
• Acquired deep feature-level domain knowledge, validating high-concurrency transaction workflows, data integrity, and regulatory compliance standards.
• Effectively handled on-call support, resolving version set inconsistencies, diagnosing build pipeline blockers, and facilitating smooth production deployments.

Skills:
• Test Automation Tools & Frameworks: Selenium WebDriver, Playwright, Pytest, Cypress, Rest Assured, WebDriverIO, TestNG, Robot Framework.
• API Data & Service Testing: Rest Assured, Postman, Swagger, Soap UI, Karate Framework, JSON / XML Payload Validation.
• Programming & Scripting Languages: Python, Java (Core Java, OOP, Data Structures), JavaScript, SQL.
• BDD / TDD & Test Frameworks: Cucumber (BDD), Gherkin, Page Object Model (POM).
• Testing Types and Methodologies: CI/CD, Functional, Regression, Re-Testing, Load, Exploratory, Risk-Based Testing, Release Management Testing, Test Planning & Test Strategy, Agile (Scrum / Kanban).
• Test Management, Defect Tracking & Reporting: JIRA, Bug Reporting & Root Cause Analysis.
• Network, Debugging & Monitoring Tools: AWS, Charles Proxy, Fiddler, API Request/Response Debugging, Log Analysis.
• Version Control: GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Git, SVN.
• AI-Driven Testing & GenAI Tools: Claude, GenAI-assisted Test Case Generation, GitHub Copilot.
• Database: SQL server.

Projects:
Credit Processing Platform (Corecredit V2)
• Created and maintained scalable automated regression suites and backend validations for Enterprise SaaS & Cloud Microservices Platforms, ensuring high transaction reliability.
• Designed and executed exhaustive functional, integration, regression, and re-testing scenarios across multiple production release cycles.
• Completed end-to-end API test suites using Postman and Rest Assured to validate backend microservices, contracts, and schema variations.
• Validated database consistency, transaction states, and recommendation outputs using complex SQL queries and data assertions.
• Automated mission-critical regression workflows using Rest Assured with Python, reducing manual verification effort by 65%.
• Conducted performance, stress, and load testing using JMeter to identify throughput bottlenecks and latency spikes.
• Logged, prioritized, and tracked defects in JIRA, collaborating closely with developers for expedited root cause resolution.
• Actively contributed to SDLC discussions, grooming user stories and catching high-risk edge cases prior to development.
• Created and maintained QA artifacts including execution matrices, test summary reports, and defect analytics dashboards.
• Designed and validated end-to-end transaction flows, authorization lifecycles, and audit compliance mechanisms.
• Prepared detailed release sign-off reports and communicated quality readiness directly to cross-functional stakeholders.

AI-Powered Test Script Generation Engine using LLM.
• Developed an AI-driven engine using Ollama LLM to auto-generate PyTest scripts from natural language test scenarios.
• As a QA Automation Engineer, I developed this project to address the challenges of manual test case scripting and the time-consuming nature of regression test creation. The goal was to leverage Large Language Models LLMs) to automatically generate PyTest scripts from natural language testing scenarios, improving productivity and consistency across automation workflows.
• Created a dataset by scraping web applications to help the model identify and map UI elements automatically.
• Reduced test case development time by 60% and increased regression suite scalability.
